decision_reason: Four-component composition verified for 401 samples and all 150 pairs. Six prespecified primary models are full rank and converge without separation or non-finite estimates; 12 model results reproduce. Stage 1-4 and Stage 5 v1 files remain unchanged. No pathway passes the Bonferroni multiplicity gate; PROCEED is based on technical validity. Stage 6 robustness and external-validation eligibility remain deferred.
